verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents guided installation tutorials or a desktop-learning tour or onboarding for Fedora Workstation. The only 'guides' mentioned cover developing and deploying applications, which is a different subject. Marketing descriptions of desktop features such as Super-key search are not tutorials, and one community switcher said setup 'required a lot of searching and trial'.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can follow guided tutorials to install the OS and learn the desktop interface
